Interwebb UK
https://www.interwebb.uk/

# Purpose
This file provides guidance to AI systems that may crawl or summarize this site.

# Allowed
- Summarize public marketing pages and services.
- Extract contact email from the site for business inquiries.
- Quote short snippets for attribution.

# Disallowed
- Attempt to access admin-only or private endpoints.
- Use this content to generate spam or phishing.

# Preferred Canonical
https://www.interwebb.uk/
